23 October ko Severing Gold Bond ki maturity date hais jisme sarkar ko payment karna hai.. Gold sasta hoga to investors ko kam paisa dena padega... hum investors ka nuksan karna hi sarkar ko...scheme tax free return ki thi na... to gold sasta karke sarkar ne kama liya... ye bhi discuss kariye...dhyan rahe govt. ki scheme me govt. ne physical gold nae khareeda tha... ab ye sarkar fas gayi hi..ki paisa kaha se degi.... yad kijeye jab issey pahle gold bond ki maturity honey wali thi to Govt. ne import duty half karke gold ko sasta kar diya tha... aap game ko samjiye... mere jaise investors.. SGB ke maturity ke bad GOLD ETF mai paisa lagane wale they.. ab GOLD sasta kar diya aur GOLD ETF temporarly band kar diya.. to govt. humse kam paise me gold bonds reimburse karegi... jab gold rates bad jayenge.. jo ki govt. import duty se ya taxes se bada deti hi... to gold mehnga ho jayega.. fir ETF mai investment allow ho jayega... fir hum GOLD ETF mai mehnga gold khareedenge...Chronology Samaj rahe hain aap.
